calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, first_fiscal_week, last_fiscal_week, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS ctrl_net, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns),2) AS ctrl_before, ROUND(SUM(r.returns_net),2) AS ctrl_ret, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_cancelled_or_processing', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.status IN ('cancelled','processing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_not_store900_but_WB', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order))
UNION ALL SELECT 'delivered_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS dup_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d ON d.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND d.line_no=f.line_no
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,1,2

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS test_sku_net,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.category<>'ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS sales_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpositive_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dd
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
